row.notes: Returns early unless a career session of the expected type is active ((vm+0x288)+0x88 -> +0x260). Collects entrant records (stride 0x88, career+0x2e0) that belong to the team key at vm+0x2b4 and for each active driver creates an indexed VM child node with ref "driver_in_standings" pointing at the standings row, writes the driver overall rating (Career_Get_DriverOverallRating, truncated to int) and builds a driver sub-VM (FUN_14181ed10). Then takes the latest team championship order, finds the own team position and emits 3 "team_in_standings" rows centred on it (clamped at top/bottom), marking the own-team row at vm_data+0x180. Read-only UI builder; good place to observe team/driver standings refs.
